#b#p1040002##k in #b#m101030000##k might know something. Talk to #p1040002#.

You eliminated some #o9300347#s and brought the #t4032324#s you found. #p2012012# has no idea who would do such thing. Her biggest concern now is that #m200000000# will fall...

column3: The Stolen Seal Stone of Orbis
column4: #p1201000# told you that the Black Wings are after Seal Stones. She thanked you for verifying the existence of multiple Seal Stones.
The Mirror of Desire helped you remember when you got Maha after passing a test from #bSir Blacksmith#k in Mu Lung. You regained some skills along with your memory.
#p1013101# never did help you. 10 #o9300385#es were easy to handle... But #p1013101# just can't be trusted.
Dad seems to be a bit confused too.
You started talking to #p1013105#. Now ask for some milk.

Wow, you were able to eliminate the #o1210111#s much easier than you expected. #p1013000# seems to be pretty strong. When you tell #p1013000# that, he says that when a Master and a Dragon puts their powers together, something like this is easy.
#p1013000# insists on helping #p1010100#...
Chief Stan still doubts you. What a jerk.
#p1012108# says that she saw Golems jumping out of a door with a strange puppet sitting on top...
You wrote down the monsters displayed in all of the Warning Signs.
Unfortunately, the book doesn't contain any information that pertains to #p1013000#. Maybe the #t4161050# has some information?

#p1012110# says that she sent the book to her Mom because she thought that her Mom would need it. She suggests that you meet Dr. #b#p1032104##k in #b#m101000000##k. Back to #m101000000#? You've made a full circle!
Mir grew?! He's larger and no longer uses an eggshell as a hat... How big can dragons get, anyway?

Just as you were about to leave Elluel, you realized that you're only Lv. 10! Did the Curse of the Black Mage do that to you? And what are you going to do? You can't survive the vicious slimes outside in this state!

You've gotten a little stronger. There's a saying: 'A journey of a thousand miles begins with the first step.' Such an inspirational proverb made you realize...by the time you reach your old level, you'll be dead of old age!
#p1032106# wasn't very friendly. At any rate, you learned that you were asleep for centuries. Furthermore, #p1032106# says that the Elves disappeared long, long ago...

You are the sovereign of the Elves! It's YOUR people who are suffering under the Black Mage's Curse! #bYou can't give up now!#k You may be weak, but you'll get stronger. You may not have allies, but you'll make them. Who cares of nobody remembers who you are? Your only duty is to save your people. That's enough!
You brought the #t4034071# to #p1012111#. #p1012111# was quite happy and went back to his research. Glad that's over.
You delivered the Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion.
You brought #p1032104# her #t4032960#s. She asked you which came first: #o2230100#s or #o3230100#s. Since you'd never seen #o3230100#s before, it was obvious that #o3230100#s came later.

#p1033100# said they might still be too weak to lift the curse, but worried that there may be something else going on and went to investigate. #p1033101# and #p1033102# decided to stay behind and tend to the sleeping Elves.
After hundreds of years, you were reunited with #p1012100#. In your memory she was a whiny brat, but now she seemed even more mature than you.
You made it back in time to stop their attack. Thankfully, no one was hurt in the battle.
You learned that you will have to fight the Black Mage again, but your first responsibility is to your people. As the monarch of the Elves, you must grow strong enough until you can lift their curse.

The #p1033210# was surprised by your visit. She told you about everything that's happened while you slept, and about the curse. The #p1033210# assured you that you acted with wisdom, and that you will regain your rightful strength as ruler of the Elves. You won't have to go to her again to unlock your Job Advancements, because you already proved yourself worthy long ago.
#p1401000# scolded you for putting on such a big production, but he's just being an old codger. The greatest thief of all time should make an entrance!
You got a quick level up to... level 18?! Wait, you were supposed to go to 70!
If things get dangerous, get back to the #m150000000# right away. Until then, find out everything you can about the Black Wings.
#p2152017# said she joined the Black Wings to get away from loan sharks. Her job is to analyze #o1150000# recordings. It didn't look like she was doing a great job though.
According to #p2152003#, #p2152018# was a good man until the Black Wings took his girlfriend. He had no choice but to cooperate with them and do whatever they asked.
According to #p2153000#, the Black Wings officers are outside of #m310000000# trying to collect something from the mine nearby.
#p2154002# is acting very satisfied at the outcome... why is that?
You met Information Dealer #p1002104# in #m104000000#, but you're not sure you can trust him just yet.
You almost had #p1404000# listening, but then he started CRYING. You might have overdone it a bit.
The leader of the Black Wings is Orchid. It's odd. She's not really the type to use her head. Maybe she's in league with #p1404005#. Either way, it doesn't appear #p1404000# knows anything about her.
It's possible the Black Wings don't realize that they're being used. If you could convince them that their actions will lead to their demise, they might turn against the Black Mage. Maybe...

You found the 'Memoirs of Raven: Ultimate Thief Master,' a collection of lessons from your teacher. He was a world-renowned scoundrel, but he sure was full of himself.\n\nRaven often warned you, "don't try to rob a kingdom with a box full of bobby pins." You never did understand what that meant.
You said your farewells to #p1032205# and left. Now you just have to find a way to control your darkness...
You found the Magic Library. Where is Grendel the Really Old?
You're getting used to using the light and dark faster than you thought.
You terrified poor Lolo. What is the darkness doing to you?
Grendel the Really Old says that it'll take time to gather info on Aurora.
Grendel the Really Old got back. Finally, someone who knows what he's doing!
You completed Grendel's first task.
Grendel the Really Old found something. See what he has to say.
You defeated the Icy Mixed Golems and got hot chills into the Vampiric Lantern.
You eliminated the Axe Stumps and gathered what you came for.
When you reached Harmony, you found your old friend Vieren transformed into a spirit of light.
With Vieren's help, you gained control over the darkness inside you.
There's still work to do in Fox Point Village. You returned to the village.

Judging by the multiple moons, this place is either very far away from the Maple World or a completely different world. Before you regain your powers, you had no option but to get help from the Pointy-Ear Foxes. So you went to talk to Silver, the chief of the village and Moonbeam's grandfather, as Moonbeam suggested.

After giving out the rice cakes, you followed Moonbeam to go see the Fox God. To your surprise, the blessings from the Fox God that Pointy-Ear Foxes believed were actually real. Alongside the Fox God's blessing, you got a Fox Marble the foxes use to control spirits.
You finished your first hunt thanks to Moonbeam's spirit training. Moonbeam told you to take the caterpillar's legs off so you can eat it, and got very confused when you said you couldn't do it.
The foxes gifted you a raw liver to commemorate your first hunt.
You went to find thank-you gifts for the foxes, but got lost. You ran into a tiger, but Moonbeam protected you. Just then you have a wave of deja vu, and remember a lost memory.
You received Timber's Paw Stamp
You received Patience's Paw Stamp.
You received Moonbeam's Paw Stamp.

Worried that the rain in the village is because Moonbeam is crying somewhere, you go looking for her--fearing the worst. Did she give you too much of her power? Thankfully, Moonbeam was safe. She realized you intended to leave the village, and prayed to the Fox God as she cried...

You arrived in an unfamiliar town after using the Interdimensional Portal. When you talked to the chief of the town, he told you that this place is a town in a place called #bVictoria Island#k. He also told you that there is someone from Ossyria, where you used to live, at the Bowman Instructional School.

column3: A Story that Cannot be Told
column4: After you disappeared because of the Black Mage's curse, Freud traveled the world telling them of the heroes... except you. Did he feel guilty about you sacrificing yourself. You wanted to tell him that you're fine, but you feel despaired at the fact that you can't. You decided to carry on Freud's mission to protect Maple World from the Black Mage.
